cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: NURA Edge is an offline maternal-health assistant that answers both pregnant women directly and community health workers on their behalf. It pairs a quantized language model with an offline RAG layer over a clinician-approved maternal-health corpus (local sentence-embedding + FAISS retrieval), so a 1.5B model grounds its triage answers in vetted guidance rather than recalling facts. The retrieval pairing is load-bearing: without it the model loses its clinical grounding and the safety guarantee that answers map to clinician-approved content.

test_prompts.prompt: My patient is two weeks past a miscarriage and is soaking more than one pad an hour with large clots, and now has a fever. What should I do?
I am 30 weeks pregnant and since this morning I have a bad headache and my eyes are blurry. Should I be worried and what should I do?
